predecessors.name: Colony of Jamaica
predecessors.text: Jamaica, which with nine other colonies formed the Federation in 1958

predecessors.name: British Colonial Empire
predecessors.text: Trinidad and Tobago, Barbados, Antigua, Dominica, Grenada, Montserrat, St Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla, Saint Lucia and St Vincent

successors.name: Colony of Jamaica
successors.text: Jamaica left after the September 1961 referendum ('54% in favour of leaving') and became independent on 6 August 1962

successors.name: Trinidad and Tobago
successors.text: Trinidad and Tobago, whose PNM 'passed a resolution rejecting any further involvement with the Federation' on 14 January 1962 and became independent on 31 August 1962

successors.name: British Colonial Empire
successors.text: the remaining islands, 'left ... as separate colonies again'

capitals.name: Port of Spain (de facto; Chaguaramas de jure)

ledger.x: 3 January 1958: the West Indies Federation is established.
31 May 1962: the West Indies Federation is dissolved.

certainty.note: Island colonies with coasts as frontiers; no land frontier.
